licence.note: No single vendor documentation licence covers this pack: the Splunk add-on's own conf files carry no separate licence beyond the add-on's Splunkbase terms, and Microsoft's Azure-Sentinel repository (MIT licensed) is cited for its Data Collection Rule schema, not prose. Entries here are this pack's own paraphrase, not vendor text.
